page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core operations. Single-core performance is weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression registering in the bottom 10%. However, the instance leverages its 32 dedicated cores to achieve average multi-core performance across several tests, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU benchmarks. Memory bandwidth for both small and large blocks remains in the average tier, though the Passmark memory score is weak.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g5ne.8xlarge offers a dense allocation of dedicated physical cores, making it suitable for multi-threaded workloads that can distribute processing across many cores to offset lower single-core speeds. Factual workload fits include static web serving, database operations, software compilation, and multi-threaded decompression, all of which achieved average tier results in benchmark testing. It is less suited for single-threaded tasks or memory-intensive workloads requiring high single-core throughput.
